altReasons: Scoring margin: 49ers favored (blended PD/g +8.1 vs Commanders -6.2, 0.5x this season + 0.5x 2025). Travel: 49ers favored - Commanders make a cross-country trip (DC to the Bay Area, 3-hour time change) for a prime-time game; Washington has never won at Levi's Stadium (0-2 there all-time).

Injuries/Lineup (weighted x2 - multi-starter cluster): Commanders favored - 49ers have two starters at premium positions banged up: DE Nick Bosa (edge rusher) questionable, and WR Mike Evans (Purdy's top target, effectively WR1) questionable (rib/Achilles); WR Deebo Samuel (hamstring) and LB Dre Greenlaw (suspension) are also out. Washington's lone premium-position concern is WR Stefon Diggs (hamstring, questionable) - a single-starter issue that doesn't trigger the weighted rule - so on balance the category favors Washington.

Form: 49ers favored - San Francisco is 3-0 in its last 3 (margins +6, +10, +3) with Purdy starting all three, a clearly strong, QB-change-unaffected record. Washington is 1-1-1 in its last 3, but that record was built mostly under Marcus Mariota (started 2 of those 3) rather than tonight's starter Jayden Daniels (started only 1 of the 3), so Washington's side is neutralized per the WEIGHTED-RULE; category awarded to San Francisco on its own unaffected, clearly strong form.

Matchup splits: Commanders favored - 49ers CB Upton Stout has been a clear exploitable weak link (allowing a 73.1% completion rate and 109.3 opposing passer rating this season), a specific mismatch for Washington's passing game (Diggs/McLaurin); San Francisco has also allowed the 2nd-most targets to RBs in the league, playing into Washington's receiving-back usage (Ekeler/White).
